articles.title: Global Economics Intelligence executive summary, September 2026
articles.summary: Central banks move to tighten interest rate policies as energy price spikes fuel inflation; growth looks sparse in some economies, but activity indicators see manufacturing and services expanding.

articles.title: Rewiring securities services for a new era of competition and growth
articles.summary: Disruptive forces—from real-time settlement to agentic AI—are changing the dynamics of the securities services industry. How can leaders capture the next horizon of growth?

articles.title: Agentic AI in strategic sourcing: Hype or hero?
articles.summary: As more procurement functions invest in agentic AI to capture savings and drive efficiency, the question is increasingly: Is it worth it?

articles.title: Who wins when AI does the shopping? New evidence on agentic commerce
articles.summary: Analysis of about 21,000 consumers indicates how AI shopping behavior is growing and evolving, with early evidence showing companies are not yet equipped to meet the rising demand.

articles.title: What AI can’t replace—and why it matters for value
articles.summary: AI may be deepening our crisis of connection, says Stanford research psychologist Jamil Zaki. Managing change with empathy helps leaders build trust, strengthen relationships, and get the most out of their AI investments.
